title: Three models added to the lineup
summary:
Three models joined the configuration, three community projects joined the directory, and the speech API example got its fields in the right places.

Model configuration now includes `openai-reasoning` with text and image input, `llama-vision` for image understanding, and `gemini` using Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview. The `openai` and `openai-large` aliases also changed their underlying models.

The project listings gained DesmondBot, a snarky bot built with the text API and OpenWebUI; OkeyAI, which focuses on African languages and cultural contexts; and BlackWave, a text-to-image app.

The OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech POST docs now show `modalities: ["text", "audio"]` and place `voice` and `format` inside the `audio` object. The parameter table was updated to match.

highlights.title: Reasoning with image input
highlights.text: `openai-reasoning` was added using OpenAI o4-mini, with support for text and image input. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

highlights.title: Llama gets vision
highlights.text: `llama-vision` was added using Llama 3.2 11B Vision. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-vision).

highlights.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview
highlights.text: `gemini` was added using Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).
